Normalization.raw_Binary_Add: Only Binary with op Add in these SAFEinputs maps to currentK ngAdd/normalized kind Add. No general Binary/equality/subtraction type introduced.
Normalization.raw_Constructor: CurrentK normalized tag Construct, not Constructor. Pattern Constructor tag remains Constructor.
Normalization.raw_Ctor_parent_type: Each normalizedCtor row includes parent type_id as encoded in ngCtor, in addition to ctor_id/source_order/field_types.
Normalization.raw_Match: scrutineeExpr maps to scrutinee; sourceArmId to source_arm_id; bodyExpr to body. Event body_expr_id remains a DISTINCT existing label.
Normalization.raw_Call: function maps to name_id, args to arguments; functiondefinition returnType to return_type_id and bodyExpr to body.
Normalization.raw_Let: valueExpr maps to bound_expr, bodyExpr to body_expr; binder unchanged.
Normalization.raw_ExprId: exprId maps to row id; occurrence remains independent, not a rowkey replacement.
Normalization.raw_name_fields: Variable name maps name_id; parameter name maps name_id.
Normalization.display_metadata: SAFEinput TypeDecl.name, constructor.name, function.sourceName are descriptive source sidecars not fields in currentK carriers. Preserve them in SAFEinput document; do not invent/insert them into currentK Program or drop any actualK Program field. No primary canonical ID claim.
Normalization.list_order: Every declaration/constructor/node/function/parameter/argument/arm/pattern-field/value-field/binding/event/frame list retains source/state order. Only environmentMap rows sort by numeric name_id, retaining every row.
Normalization.Match_wire: Exact complete recursivePattern/Arm/BindingPaths declarations separately in PUBLIC-MATCH-WIRE-DECLARATIONS.json.

observer_policy: Allobservedstateordinals; derive range(actual_states length) before opening anyexpected; no separatecuts/resume.
no_model_change: All declarations describe unchanged alreadyreviewedactualpassedK model/codec. No new fullwireversion/profile, evaluator branch, fieldalias or sourceadmission guard.
